targets.label: probable_i2c_bus_recovery
targets.evidence: Configures the confirmed TWI pins with open-drain-like behavior, clocks SCL up to nine times while sampling SDA, then emits a stop-like transition; attached device remains unknown.

targets.label: candidate_i2c_driver_init
targets.evidence: Registers state, conditionally calls probable_i2c_bus_recovery, and reaches the confirmed Nordic TWI register initializer; attached device remains unknown.

targets.label: candidate_i2c_instance_init
targets.evidence: Calls candidate_i2c_driver_init as part of a larger initialization path.

targets.label: candidate_i2c_instance_start
targets.evidence: Small direct caller of candidate_i2c_driver_init, itself reached from application code.

targets.label: candidate_i2c_application_setup
targets.evidence: Constructs the configuration consumed by the confirmed TWI register initializer: P0.25 SCL, P0.24 SDA, and 400 kbit/s.

targets.label: candidate_twi_hal_init
targets.evidence: Writes configuration fields to Nordic TWI PSEL.SCL, PSEL.SDA, and FREQUENCY registers.

targets.label: candidate_twi_hal_enable
targets.evidence: Writes the enabled-TWI value to the Nordic TWI ENABLE register.

targets.label: candidate_twi_hal_uninit
targets.evidence: Lower-level TWI-family lifecycle function called before reinitialization.

targets.label: candidate_twi_hal_transfer
targets.evidence: Writes the descriptor address to the Nordic TWI ADDRESS register and selects lower-level RX/TX paths by transfer type.

targets.label: candidate_twi_queue_process
targets.evidence: Builds or selects a queued operation and calls candidate_twi_hal_transfer.

targets.label: candidate_twi_queue_complete
targets.evidence: Small queue-family function called from TWI instance lifecycle paths.

targets.label: candidate_twi_instance_lifecycle
targets.evidence: Calls instance initialization plus queue processing and completion functions.

targets.label: candidate_twi_transaction_schedule
targets.evidence: Queues an application transaction pointer and starts processing the TWI manager instance.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_transaction_dispatch
targets.evidence: Loads a 16-byte application operation record and selects candidate EEPROM write or read helpers.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_block_crc16
targets.evidence: Implements CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE and is called over each block after its leading stored CRC word.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_table_startup
targets.evidence: Iterates all nine EEPROM block records, reads each block, validates its leading CRC, and synchronizes the associated copy.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_write_chunk
targets.evidence: Builds register-prefixed TWI writes split at 16-byte logical-address boundaries.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_write_finalize
targets.evidence: Finalizes a completed write state or schedules its next chunk.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_transfer_complete
targets.evidence: Handles read/write completion, advances chunk state, retries failures up to three times, and invokes the application callback.

targets.label: candidate_twi_application_registration
targets.evidence: Receives the same global TWI manager instance immediately after application setup; inspect for transaction registration or scheduling.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_write
targets.evidence: Builds a TWI operation from a 16-bit application address, payload pointer, length, and callback.

targets.label: candidate_eeprom_read
targets.evidence: Builds a combined TWI register-address write followed by a read into an application buffer.

targets.label: candidate_application_startup
targets.evidence: Calls candidate_i2c_application_setup and then passes the same manager instance to candidate_twi_application_registration.

targets.label: probable_ieee802154_timeslot_timer
targets.evidence: Direct timer references and XREF to the Nordic IEEE 802.15.4 SoftDevice radio scheduler source path.
